headline: Siegfried Mureșan Announces What Will Happen to Pensions and Salaries in 2027: 'There Will Be Increases'
summary: Siegfried Mureșan said pensions and public sector salaries could increase in 2027, with the size depending on available funds when the budget is drafted. He ruled out raising taxes and duties.
why: Pension and public wage decisions drive Romania's fiscal deficit, which influences its sovereign debt rating, bond yields and the leu.

original_headline: Siegfried Mureșan anunță ce se întâmplă cu pensiile și salariile în 2027: „Vom avea creșteri”
